Name: Previous Month Loan Originations
Expression:
CALCULATE(
    [Total Original Loan Amount],
    DATEADD(DateTable[Date], -1, MONTH)
)

Name: MoM Loan Growth %
Expression:
VAR Previous_Month =
    [Previous Month Loan Originations]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(
        [Total Original Loan Amount] - Previous_Month,
        Previous_Month
    )

Name: YoY Loan Growth %
Expression:
VAR Previous_Year =
    [Previous Year Loan Originations]
RETURN
    DIVIDE(
        [Total Original Loan Amount] - Previous_Year,
        Previous_Year
    )
